GET  /admin/v1/users/directorysync
directory_key
The external directory sync's unique identifier.
directory_type
The type of external directory sync. One of:
activedirectory , azure , google , or
openldap .
last_full_sync_result
The outcome of the last full sync attempt, either
completed  or failed .
last_full_sync_time
Timestamp of the last full sync.
name
The name of the directory sync.
paused
Whether automatic sync of this directory is paused;
true  or false .
